name: Impetus of Hermes
description:
Upon [term:blink][dark-gray]blinking[/dark-gray][/term], you engage in [dark-green]divine trickery[/dark-green], a brief [term:stealth][dark-gray]stealth[/dark-gray][/term] that empowers your next attack +2♥️, and create a [blue]shortcut[/blue] for 4 seconds that you can enter once to return to the other end. If the shortcut expires unused, you engage in [dark-green]divine trickery[/dark-green] once more.

[dark-gray]"The most sublime victory delivers them bewilderment."[/dark-gray]
